units.name: FieldLoadGraphics
units.summary: Far entry 1 of field bank 2 (banks 0 and 4 hold unreferenced copies of this code): loads the field palette ($86F0) and the two CHR bank sets ($8710 NMI half, $8720 IRQ half).

units.name: FieldStreamUpdate
units.summary: Far entry 0 of the field bank: per-frame background streaming while the camera scrolls. When CameraXSpeed is nonzero a metatile column is queued, when CameraYSpeed is nonzero a metatile row; the attribute row/column jobs run on every 8th frame or with vertical motion. All output goes to PpuUploadBuffer for the NMI.

units.name: SelectMetatileSet
units.summary: Chooses MetatileSetPtr ($8AF0 or $8A30) by whether StreamSrcPtr is above $A410 (field region split).

phase1.evidence: [L-009] Coherent routine(s), 22 official-opcode instructions decoding exactly between known code/regions in banks [2, 3, 30, 31]; no JSR/JMP/word reference found anywhere in PRG (no caller found; unreferenced, not observed). Structural support: short complete routine ending in RTS/JMP, contiguous with neighbouring routines. Bank 2 $8088 is byte-identical to bank 26 SetSplitScanline.

units.name: CalcFieldSplitScanline
units.summary: Uncalled (no caller found): byte-identical copy of bank 26 SetSplitScanline. IrqScanline = $390 - CameraY, forced to 0 when negative or below 8 and to $F0 when $E8 or more.

units.summary: Queues the tiles of one metatile row (two tile rows, split at the nametable edge) into PpuUploadBuffer.

units.name: QueueRowTilesTop
units.summary: Copies the upper tile pair of each metatile of the row into the upload entry.

units.name: QueueRowTilesBottom
units.summary: Copies the lower tile pair of each metatile of the row into the upload entry.

units.summary: Nametable address of the incoming column.

units.name: ColumnNametableSelect
units.summary: Chooses the nametable half for the incoming column from CameraX.

units.name: QueueMetatileColumn
units.summary: Queues one metatile column as two vertical (+32 increment) upload entries.

units.summary: Left tile pair of each metatile in the column.

regions.summary: Code: SndInit, SndStart, SndStartStream, SndUpdate, SndUpdate_SlotLoop, SndUpdate_SlotLoop_Cont ...

units.name: SndInit
units.summary: Far entry 0: silences the APU and marks all 8 channel slots ($15 bytes each from $0640) free ($FF).

units.name: SndStart
units.summary: Far entry 1: SoundRequest selects a 4-byte record at $86E2; each byte other than $FF is a stream number started with SndStartStream.

units.name: SndStartStream
units.summary: Stream A -> 4-byte record at $8796 (slot offset, flags, data pointer). Releases the channel bits of the sound already in that slot, stores the new pointer and marks the slot starting.

units.name: SndUpdate
units.summary: Far entry 2 (each NMI): clears the effect channel mask, ticks, updates the fly-ball tone, then runs every slot.

units.name: SndUpdate_SlotLoop
units.summary: Per slot: hardware channel = flags&3; slot state 0 = start new data, $FF = idle, else advance pitch/volume envelopes and, when the note timer expires, read the next commands.

units.name: SndUpdate_SlotLoop_Cont
units.summary: Shared entry inside SndUpdate_SlotLoop: branch/jump target reached from another routine.

units.name: SndUpdate_SlotLoop_Cont2
units.summary: Shared entry inside SndUpdate_SlotLoop: branch/jump target reached from another routine.

units.name: SndUpdate_NextSlot
units.summary: Advances X by $15 to the next slot until all 8 are done.

units.name: SndSlotBegin
units.summary: Initialises a slot from the header of its data stream (tempo, envelope, duty, length).

units.name: SndReadCommands
units.summary: Interprets the slot's data stream: notes, rests, loops and parameter commands (large command decoder).

units.name: CheckLargeLead

units.name: CheckGameOver
units.summary: Standard end-of-game test on HalfInning (0 = top 1st): carry set = game over. Before the bottom of the 9th (< 17) never; from half 36 always (18-inning limit). After a top half the game ends when the home side leads (its last line-score cell is marked X); after a full inning it ends unless the score is tied.

units.name: SubstStepWaitList
units.summary: Step 0: waits for all 27 lineup lines, then puts the cursor on the default player (DefaultSubstSlot).

units.name: SubstStepChooseOut
units.summary: Step 1: cursor on the lineup (SubstCursorKeys). A on READY ($0A) ends the screen; A on a player remembers him in MenuCursor and moves the second cursor to the first selectable bench player: a pitcher ($13+) when the chosen player is the pitcher or the side is fielding, otherwise a bench fielder ($0A+). With no candidate the choice is cancelled.

units.name: SubstStepChooseIn
units.summary: Step 2: second cursor on the bench (SubstBenchKeys). B cancels to step 1; A moves the bench player into the chosen lineup slot (his bench slot becomes $FF). A pitcher coming in clears the side's fatigue counter. Plays sound $13 plus side sample $0B (pitcher) or $0C (fielder).

units.name: BatContact
units.summary: Bat/ball contact test, each frame of the pitch. With the batter swinging (animation $40-$6F, or state $13 = bunt) and the ball at the plate (BallXHi < $68), ContactHorizontal/ContactHeight give an index into the swing type's ContactWindowPtrs table; a value other than $FF is a hit: sets PitchFlags bit0, clears PlayTimer and returns the value in X. With the batter not swinging (animation 0): 1 frame in 8 (RngState & $70 = 0), when the ball is at the plate and ContactDepth reports it at the batter's body, the batter object enters state $20 (batter group 2, see BatterGroup2Dispatch) and the pitch ends (BallState 0). This is the only writer of batter state $20: the hit by pitch (L-016, runtime-confirmed).

units.name: MainLoop

A mode with bit7 set restarts at MainModeInit.

units.name: MainLoop_StartMenu

units.name: NmiHandler
units.summary: NMI: sprite DMA, PPUMASK, DMC start timer. When NmiFlags bit7 is clear (no bank switch in progress) it uploads the palette or the PPU upload buffer, sets scroll, applies CHR banks and the split IRQ, runs the current mode's NMI entry (or the Start-menu text drawers), services the sound driver (bank 8 entry 2) unless a DMC sample is playing, and counts frames. Always sets NmiFlags bit0. If an MMC3 write sequence was interrupted it resumes it through RestartBankSwitch.
